mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS id, p.shop_id AS shop_id, p.category_id AS category_id, p.name AS name, p.description AS description, p.thumbnail_img AS thumbnail_img, p.sold_count AS sold_count, p.rating AS rating, MIN(v.price) AS min_price, MAX(v.price) AS max_price FROM products p INNER JOIN product_variants v ON p.id = v.product_id WHERE p.id = #{productId} AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY p.id, p.shop_id, p.category_id, p.name, p.description, p.thumbnail_img, p.sold_count, p.rating
SELECT v.id AS id, v.product_id AS product_id, v.sku AS sku, v.name AS name, v.price AS price, v.primary_img AS primary_img FROM product_variants v WHERE v.product_id = #{productId}

SELECT pi.id AS id, pi.image_type AS image_type, pi.image_url AS url FROM product_images pi LEFT JOIN product_variants pv ON pv.id = pi.variant_id WHERE pi.product_id = #{productId} OR pv.product_id = #{productId}

SELECT DISTINCT pa.id AS attribute_id, pa.name AS attribute_name, pav.id AS value_id, pav.value AS value FROM product_variants pv JOIN variant_attribute_value vav ON vav.variant_id = pv.id JOIN product_attribute_values pav ON pav.id = vav.attribute_value_id JOIN product_attributes pa ON pa.id = pav.attribute_id WHERE pv.product_id = #{productId}
SELECT pv.id AS variant_id, vav.attribute_value_id AS attribute_value_id FROM product_variants pv JOIN variant_attribute_value vav ON vav.variant_id = pv.id WHERE pv.product_id = #{productId}

WITH RECURSIVE category_tree AS ( SELECT id, parent_id, name, slug, 0 AS depth FROM categories WHERE id = #{categoryId}
UNION ALL
SELECT c.id, c.parent_id, c.name, c.slug, ct.depth + 1 FROM categories c JOIN category_tree ct ON c.id = ct.parent_id )
SELECT id, name, slug FROM category_tree ORDER BY depth DESC
